name: Tehuacán

requestOutcomes.outcome: Official municipal portal loaded anonymously; it links municipal services including online predial payment, but no parcel geometry service was exposed in the bounded inspection.

Official municipal Catastro catalog loaded. It identifies the Dirección de Información Geográfica y Catastro and describes cadastral identification, location, delimitation, registration, cartography, valuation, and updating; no parcel feature response was provided.

Official municipal Clave Catastral service loaded. It states that a unique cadastral key identifies a property and gives the municipal service location; no identity or geometry lookup endpoint was exposed.
Official Puebla government service page identifies the Delegación Catastral en la Circunscripción Territorial de Tehuacán and a cadastral location certificate process; procedural evidence only.
Connection failed during bounded ordinary HTTPS GET. This is not evidence of service absence and no TLS exception or retry bypass was used.
Official Puebla legal publication on cadastral zoning and valuation tables; planning/valuation evidence only, not parcel geometry.

schemaAndCrs.inspection: No public anonymous map/API response containing a stable parcel identity plus geometry was obtained. The municipal pages describe cadastral services and safe procedural metadata only.
